title: Andijan reservoir
river: Kara Darya, head of the Syr Darya
headline: Lake down 50 % since 23 Jun (clear-day photos); about 19.5 km² expected in Dec

sections.p: The lake's open water fell from 45.1 km² on 14 Jul to 32.3 km² on 30 Oct 2026: 28 % less. NISAR measured it every 12 days, also on the days clouds hid it from cameras. Clear-day photos show a bigger fall, 42.1 → 21.1 km² (50 % less, 23 Jun to 19 Oct): in autumn the radar still counts wet mud on the drying shore as water.

Water is let out all summer for cotton, wheat and orchards downstream; the release season ends in September. Winter brings little use and river inflow from Kyrgyzstan's mountains, so the lake refills until spring.

Next month (Dec): about 19.5 km² (8 in 10 chance 13–26 km²); a typical Dec holds 22.2 km², the lowest was 16.7 km² in 2021. By Feb: about 25.8 km² (typical 25.6). Learned from 95 clear months since 2017; 30 days ahead it beat the best simple guess by 13 % on months it never saw. Beyond a month we show the 10-year range, because the model is no better than the seasonal pattern there.

Summer water for the valley's fields came from this lake; by 30 Oct it held 72 % of its summer size. Watch the winter refill: if the lake reaches the forecast by spring, early-season water should be close to normal; if it stays lower, plan for a tighter first irrigation.

You get the lake's area every 12 days, cloud or not (34 % of camera visits in 2025 were cloudy). Our learned map agrees with clear-day photos at IoU 0.63 (the old one-number rule: 0.59); its typical miss is 7.6 km², mostly wet mud counted as water in late summer. A second NASA satellite (ICESat-2 laser) agrees: water level and area rise and fall together (rank correlation 0.95, 9 passes).
10.9 million people live in the three valley regions this water reaches (Andijan, Fergana, Namangan; 29 % of Uzbekistan). A smaller lake in winter means less water to share in spring.

confidence: Learned water map IoU 0.63 vs photos (leave-one-date-out, 8 days); shuffled-label control 0.07; laser rank correlation 0.95.
sources: NASA-ISRO NISAR GCOV (provisional before 21 Oct 2026); ESA Sentinel-2 (photo check); NASA ICESat-2 ATL13; stat.uz population 1 Oct 2025.
